expectedRealization.rationale: Project-volume ramp can continue for multiple quarters even if commodity prices cool, but the sector price regime is already adverse.

changeHypothesis.summary: Copper and industrial metals had reached record highs, then Chinese policy intervention pushed the sector into an adverse price regime. 紫金 differs from a pure price-beta miner because a multi-year copper/gold production ramp was already visible, but current entry timing remained poor enough to block High-priority.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Kamoa-Kakula, Serbia and Tibet project ramps are multi-year physical volume drivers independent of a single copper-price spike.
disconfirmingEvidence: Chinese reserve releases and anti-speculation policy capped the commodity rerating.
Metals basket and 紫金 were negative versus CSI300 over 20d/60d.
The frozen baseline already projected very strong 2021-23 earnings growth.

causalChain.mechanism: Large projects entering production lift physical output regardless of short-term market multiples.
Higher physical output on strong copper/gold prices expands absolute profit.
causalChain.failureMode: commodity prices fall faster than volume grows

causalChain.mechanism: Alpha requires structural volume growth to offset an adverse commodity-policy regime and beat an already-high forecast path.

directWinners: low-cost miners with funded volume growth
losers: high-cost smelters/downstream users if raw materials stay high
falseThemeMatches: metal producers whose earnings rely only on peak spot prices
